# Award assessment

The prize considers three dimensions: **A — problem longevity**, **B — publication venue**, and **C — public scholarly recognition**.

Published award records identify the problem, awarded level, and recipients. Assessment thresholds, venue lists, dimension values, calculation methods, and internal deliberations are not part of this public repository.

The repository records announced decisions; it does not calculate grades or payment allocations. See [confirmed awards](../awards/README.md) and the [record guide](records.md).
